layout_vs_placement.note: D = (FAST/NONE as compiled) / (FAST/NONE aligned), the pooled geometric mean over jobs. The layout A/A moves only NONE's loops (NONE against NONE aligned); D moves both builds' loops, so D / layout A/A ratio is what the pooled numbers imply for FAST's own placement shift (arithmetic on two pooled ratios from separate timings of the same binaries; implied_fast_side_ratio).

noise.definition: a process is slow when it takes more than 5% longer than the fastest process of the same series (one side of one cell, in one job); the excess is that process's time over the fastest, in percent; p_slow_after_slow is the share of slow processes among those whose previous repetition on the same side was slow. Descriptive only: no cause is established and no hardware counter was read.
